Bioresonance • Frequency Therapy • Emotional Release • AO Scan • Biotensor

We’re delighted to welcome Samadhi Hart Bioresonance to The Wellness Collective.

✨ MEET SAMADHI
Samadhi Hart is a Qualified Bioresonance Practitioner with 38 years of experience in natural health and healing modalities.

Her qualifications include a Diploma in Iridology and Remedial Massage Therapy, and she has been qualified in and practising Bioresonance Therapy since 2007.

Samadhi also practises Emotional Balancing Therapy and teaches practitioners and patients Biotensor diagnostic skills for use in their practices and daily lives.

Her approach views the body as an interconnected system rather than focusing solely on individual symptoms. She works with a range of complementary and alternative wellness therapies and takes a bio-individual approach with each client.

Samadhi grew up on the Sunshine Coast and has lived in Indonesia and Israel, bringing many years of experience and a broad perspective to her natural health practice.


🌊 BIORESONANCE / FREQUENCY THERAPY
Samadhi's Bioresonance and Frequency Therapy uses specialised frequency technology as part of a whole-body wellness approach.

During a session, you relax on a comfortable treatment bed with a frequency mat beneath you while holding hand electrodes or placing your feet on plate electrodes.
Samadhi works with a five-element protocol and specialised frequency vials from Germany, based on the areas being explored during your consultation.
Sessions also include detox and energy-stabilising protocols.
Depending on your individual needs, Samadhi may also discuss lifestyle, dietary and nutritional considerations.
What to bring
For your initial appointment, you may be asked to bring:
• Samples of supplements and medications you currently take
• Relevant environmental allergens such as flowers or grasses
• Chemicals or other substances you believe may be relevant
Wear loose, comfortable clothing and make sure you have eaten and had water before your appointment.
BIORESONANCE PRICES
Initial Consultation — $250 | 2 hours
A comprehensive initial consultation and health history.
30 minutes — $75
60 minutes — $125
90 minutes — $187.50
120 minutes — $250


💚 BIORESONANCE TREATMENT PLANS
For clients wanting to undertake a series of sessions, discounted prepaid treatment plans are available.
Treatment Plan A
3 x 60-minute treatments — $350
Valid for 3 months from purchase.
That's a saving of $25 compared with three individual 60-minute sessions.
Treatment Plan B
6 x 60-minute treatments — $700
Valid for 6 months from purchase.
That's a saving of $50 compared with six individual 60-minute sessions.
Treatment Plan C
12 x 60-minute treatments — $1,400
Valid for 12 months from purchase.
That's a saving of $100 compared with twelve individual 60-minute sessions.
Your first session is booked online and the remaining sessions are manually scheduled for you.


🌸 HART METHOD EMOTIONAL RELEASE THERAPY
The Hart Method of Emotional Release Therapy is Samadhi's approach to exploring emotional and energetic influences that may be affecting a person's wellbeing.
The method works with concepts including:
• Emotional patterns
• Beliefs and attitudes
• Past and present experiences
• Relationships
• Chakras
• The five-element system
• Emotional and energetic blockages
The intention is to help identify patterns and explore more supportive beliefs, responses and behaviours.
Samadhi describes the work as focusing on emotional and energetic influences and the way experiences and belief patterns may affect how we respond to life.
EMOTIONAL RELEASE THERAPY PRICES
Initial Consultation — $250 | 2 hours
30 minutes — $75
60 minutes — $125
90 minutes — $187.50
120 minutes — $250
60-minute sessions can also be accessed remotely
The current booking system states that the 60-minute Emotional Release Therapy session is available in person or via phone/device.


🔮 SOLEX AO SCAN
The Solex AO Scan is a non-invasive frequency scanning system that uses a sensitive bone-transducer headset to analyse thousands of frequency patterns.
A personalised scan generates a graphical report, which is sent to the client by email.
INNER VOICE — EMOTIONAL SCAN
The Inner Voice scan uses a sound-harmonising approach to generate audio frequencies intended to support emotional balance.
Following the scan, a personalised 5-minute optimising harmonics soundbite is generated, together with a report and audio pulse recording for the client to listen to at home.
AO SCAN PRICE
Please check the online booking system for the current AO Scan price and availability.


🌀 BIOTENSOR TRAINING & WORKSHOPS
Samadhi teaches Biotensor diagnostic skills to practitioners and individuals wanting to learn how to use a Biotensor in their practice and everyday life.
BIOTENSOR BASICS WORKSHOP
The workshop introduces participants to the use of a Samavaya Biotensor and how it can be applied in health and wellness contexts.
Upcoming workshop dates and pricing are announced through Samadhi's mailing list and social media.
Current workshop dates: TBA


🌿 SAMAVAYA BIOTENSOR
Samadhi also offers the Samavaya Biotensor, designed and engineered in Australia for practitioners and home use.
The Biotensor has a weighted solid-brass handle and disc end, with a removable tensor wire.
It is used by practitioners within various energy-testing and wellness practices, including nutritional and environmental testing.
What's included:
• Samavaya Biotensor
• Optional cloth storage wrap
Available to purchase directly through Samadhi's online store.


🌱 A WHOLE-BODY APPROACH
Samadhi's philosophy is based on looking at the body as an integrated system rather than treating isolated symptoms.
Her practice focuses on bio-individuality, recognising that each person is different and that what is appropriate for one person may not be appropriate for another.
Her intention is to help clients better understand the interconnected nature of their wellbeing and explore factors that may be placing strain on their system.


👩‍🌿 WHY WORK WITH SAMADHI?
With almost four decades of experience in natural health and healing modalities, Samadhi brings together extensive practical experience with a range of complementary approaches.
She has been practising Bioresonance Therapy since 2007 and also has qualifications in Iridology and Remedial Massage Therapy.
She works with both adults and children and provides individualised sessions based on each client's needs.

New and existing clients can book directly through Samadhi’s online booking system.
📱 0401 064 408
✉️ info@samadhihart.com.au
🌐 https://samadhihart.com.au
If Samadhi is with a client and unable to answer the phone, please leave a message or send a text, and she will respond as soon as possible.


🌸 IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Samadhi Hart Bioresonance provides complementary and alternative wellness services.
These services should not be represented as a substitute for diagnosis or treatment from a qualified medical practitioner.
The Solex AO Scan is specifically stated on Samadhi's website not to be a medical device and not to diagnose, treat or cure disease.
Individual experiences and outcomes vary.
CANCELLATION POLICY
Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 48 hours before the consultation.
Changes within 24 hours attract a 50% cancellation/rescheduling fee.
Non-attendance attracts a 100% cancellation fee.
Please check the current booking terms when making your appointment.
